name: B10-0423/2026 – After recital Q – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: Qa. whereas the current declarations of the absence of conflicts of interest submitted by senior EU officials and political leaders have proven insufficient to ensure integrity, transparency and accountability and to prevent corruption and undue influence owing to the discretionary nature of the information provided, the lack of information on the origin of assets and interests, and the absence of systematic and independent verification mechanisms;
